## What changes and why?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Verification

List commands run and their results. For native behavior, include OS/hardware and
what you exercised; mark anything not tested. Add screenshots for visual changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and related documentation is updated.
- [ ] Behavior changes have relevant test coverage, or an explanation above.
- [ ] Generated TypeScript contracts and lockfiles are updated when applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, personal meeting content, or downloaded models are included.
